mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST < 570 and RSAFS < 360000, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 129000 and UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 570 thousand units indicates a weakening in the housing sector, which is a key component of consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 570, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals immediate monetary easing, which boosts short-term equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
